arguments.body:
Dear Nadia,

I hope you're well. I wanted to confirm that I've received your reminder regarding the master services agreement with Harbor Analytics, which expires on 2026-11-30. I understand the importance of having legal approval for any renewal terms before sharing them externally.

Please let me know if there are any additional details or actions required from my side to facilitate the renewal process.

Best regards,
Amira
